title: finite-dreaming
description: Morphism: memory claims -> derived claims. The FINITE dream (kappa < omega; strict-finite / settling regime): a monotone closure operator iterated to its least fixed point (Knaster-Tarski) over a FIXED claim-vocabulary -- local-derivation rules (composition, generalization, contradiction-surfacing). It only RECOMBINES existing claims (no new vocabulary), so it cannot invent facts; learning-tier output that yields to sense. It is the shadow of aperiodic-dreaming collapsed through the transfinite and Scott-continuous regimes. Network-free and deterministic, so it runs in the per-turn Stop hook.
